name: WindowControls
summary: A desktop window's caption buttons: Minimise, Maximise (Restore Down while maximised) and Close, at the end of an app's title bar. For a desktop-app replica or a product that draws its own window frame. Not for closing a dialog or pane (their own close button) or for app-wide actions (TitleBar `actions`).
a11y: A `group` named "Window"; each button is named by what it does now, so a maximised window's middle button is "Restore Down" and its glyph changes with it.

props.name: state
props.description: The window's state, owned by the parent. A minimised or closed window is the parent's to show (one line and a way back).

props.name: onChange
props.description: A caption button was pressed: Minimise gives `minimised`, Maximise `maximised`, Restore Down `normal`, Close `closed`.

props.name: labels
props.description: The buttons' names, in the app's language; the defaults are the desktop's own.

props.name: icons
props.description: Glyphs for each button, when the app draws its own; the defaults are core's.
